title: Ivugwa mu Kintu
intro: Hari umuntu ugaragara mu mateka yera, afite ibitangaza byarenze gahunda karemano. Uyu muntu yahageze binyuze mu itegeko rimwe ry'Imana, arengera umubyeyi ibirego bikomeye, maze ava muri iyi si mbere y'uko iminyururu yo ku isi ibasha kumuboha. Inkuru ihera ku mwana muto kugeza mu ijuru. Uyu ashobora kuba ari nde?
clues: Natumwe nk'ikimenyetso n'imbabazi biturutse kuri Allah ku bana ba Isirayeli.
Kuza kwanjye kwari gutandukanye n’uko byari bimeze mbere hose — nabayeho kubera ijambo ry’Imana 'Baho!' nta data wo ku isi.
Umubyeyi wanjye yahuye n'ibitutsi bikomeye, ariko ihishurirwa ryera ryaramanutse kugira ngo ryerekane ko ari umwere kandi rizamure umwanya wabo.
Nkiri uruhinja, natunguye abari hafi yanjye mvuga neza kuva nkiri umwana kugira ngo nemeze izina ry'umubyeyi wanjye.
Ku bw'uburenganzira bwa Allah, naremye ubuzima nkoresheje ibumba ridafite ubuzima, mpumura impumyi, kandi nkiza umunyamibembe nkoresheje gukoraho.
Nazamuwe mu ijuru mbere yuko ikibi kingeraho, kandi nzagaruka muri iyi si mbere yuko Isaha ya nyuma igera.

trial.answer: Kuvuga kuva mu bwana bwe akiri uruhinja

options: Azamurwa mu ijuru, azagaruka mbere y'umunsi w'urubanza
Yakuye abana ba Isirayeli mu Misiri
Yabaye umwami ufite ububasha ku majini, abantu n'inyoni
outcome.answer: Azamurwa mu ijuru, azagaruka mbere y'umunsi w'urubanza

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
